name: brand-avocado
title: Avocado brand theme
description: The avocado theme (아보카도) — a complete alternate look: a green brand (hue 130) with an amber accent held at an absolute angle, a warm tinted neutral, Archivo for text with Figtree for the display roles, and 2px and 4px border chrome. Select it with `data-brand="avocado"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both — import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.
